Will Hodgkinson, Sunday News 2017: the band formed after Buck, working in a record shop, "was impressed by the Patti Smith and Velvet Underground albums that Stipe was buying."

Stipe, in Stereogum's "80 Artists Pick Their Favorite Neil Young Song": he never listened to Young much himself, but Young was a favorite of all the guys in the band, "especially Peter" -- one of the main reasons they signed to Warner Bros.

Rolling Stone's Rob Sheffield reported that Lindsey Jordan took guitar lessons from Mary Timony, calling her an "indie-rock legend" from bands including Helium and Ex Hex; Jordan herself said of her, "Everybody wants to be her."
